data.one_liner: A realistic cylindrical page-curl animation and multi-page book viewer for Flutter.
data.what_it_does: Provides a cylindrical page-curl animation with perspective, shadows, and specular sheen. Includes a complete multi-page book widget with text layout, table of contents, bookmarks, reader marks, read-aloud support, and custom route transitions.
use_when: You need a realistic book reader experience with page curl animations
You want a custom Navigator screen transition that peels the previous screen away
You need an RTL-aware page turning mechanism with zero third-party dependencies
avoid_when: You need pages to follow your finger mid-drag instead of using a fling gesture
You need widgets used as page bodies to scroll natively inside the book layout
strengths: Flexible entry points including FlipBook, PageCurlRoute, and CurlOverlay
weaknesses: Swipes fling rather than following the finger mid-drag
Widget bodies inside pages do not automatically scroll
Flips show a snapshot where animating content freezes during the curl
